title: Shotik analytics in a React Native / Expo app
rules: Follow the repo's own conventions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, lint, import aliases, file layout) when placing code.
Edit only the files a step names or detects; never change native projects (ios/, android/): the SDK has no native code.
Replace {{VARS}} before writing. Keep edits minimal and idempotent: skip a step whose `done` check already passes.
Privacy: never pass text input values, emails, names or tokens in track() props. Wrap any view showing personal data (names, health numbers, messages) in <ShotikMask>.
Analytics must not change behavior or look: no new UI, no new screens. If something here would, stop and ask.

APP_KEY.desc: Public SDK key from Shotik (Support → SDK), spk_…; the same key as Support, safe to ship

SERVER_URL.desc: Shotik server URL the phone can reach (simulator: http://127.0.0.1:4590)

SDK_SOURCE.desc: Absolute path of the SDK folder Shotik ships (sdk/react-native); the package is not on npm

SNAPSHOTS.desc: Share of sessions that record privacy-safe wireframes (0..1)

detect.how: package.json dependencies has "@shotik/support-react-native" (Support already integrated) → true
bun.lock or bun.lockb → bun; pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm; yarn.lock → yarn; else npm
"expo-router" in dependencies → expo-router; "@react-navigation/native" → react-navigation; else none
expo-router: the root _layout.tsx; if it only re-exports, follow it to the file that renders the tree. Otherwise the component passed to registerRootComponent / AppRegistry.
Outermost wrappers returned by rootComponent (GestureHandlerRootView, SafeAreaProvider, ShotikSupportProvider, …), outermost first
The ref passed to <NavigationContainer ref=…>, or none
"react-native-purchases" in dependencies → the module where Purchases.configure(...) is called
Where the app learns the signed-in user and its sign-out path
Up to 5 core user actions worth naming (e.g. start a workout, finish a lesson, share): the handler where each completes
Views that render personal data (user name, email, health values, private messages)
package.json scripts.typecheck → "<pm> run typecheck"; else "npx tsc --noEmit" when tsconfig.json exists

steps.title: Add or refresh the package
steps.note: When detect.vendored is true the folder already exists: re-copy it so src/analytics is present, then reinstall.

steps.title: Start analytics once, at module scope of the root
Wrap the tree for taps and wireframes

edits.target: The children of the outermost element in detect.providers (inside GestureHandlerRootView), or the whole returned tree when there is none

steps.title: Screen tracking

edits.anchor: the first line inside the root layout component body (a hook call at top level, before any early return)

steps.otherwise: react-navigation: after the container is ready call ShotikAnalytics.trackNavigation(detect.navigationRef); no router: ShotikAnalytics.screen('<name>') in each screen's mount effect

edits.code: ShotikAnalytics.trackRevenueCat(Purchases as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);

edits.anchor: the point where a signed-in user id is known

steps.title: Name the core actions
steps.note: At most 5. Names are snake_case verbs (walk_started, plan_completed). No personal data in props.

verify.expect: lists the root component (and the purchases/auth files when found)
exit 0, or no new errors in the files this recipe touched

verify.run: open the app on the shared simulator (device broker) and tap through two screens
verify.expect: Shotik → Insights shows the app's users and sessions within a minute
